entities.name: Zoran Slavnić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zoran "Moka" Slavnić is a Serbian retired professional basketball player and coach. He played with Crvena zvezda and with Partizan. One of the best European point guards of all time, he was named one of FIBA's 50 Greatest Players in 1991 and became a FIBA Hall of Fame player in 2013.
